plugins.name: git-tool
plugins.description: Config-driven gating plugin — reads the agents.git-tool git config, injects the matching workflow addendum, and enables the gt or gs skill plugin per-repo

plugins.name: gt
plugins.description: Graphite stacked-branch skills — submit, sync, restack, stack. Enabled per-repo by git-tool when agents.git-tool=graphite

plugins.name: gs
plugins.description: Git-Spice stacked-branch skills — submit, sync, restack, stack. Enabled per-repo by git-tool when agents.git-tool=git-spice
